title: Light New Potato and Green Bean Salad
description: A cold new potato and green bean salad with spring onion and herbs, tossed in a light apple cider vinegar and Dijon mustard dressing.
ingredients: 1kg (2lb 4oz) new potatoes, cut into roughly uniform bite-sized pieces
DRESSING: 3 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 2 garlic cloves crushed, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp honey, 1/2 tsp olive oil, salt and pepper
steps: In a medium-sized saucepan of boiling water, simmer the potatoes for 20 minutes. For the last 2 minutes, add the green beans and simmer with the potatoes. Scoop the green beans out, transfer to a colander and run under cold water.
Drain the potatoes and allow them to steam while you prepare the dressing.
Whisk together the vinegar, garlic, mustard, honey and olive oil in a small bowl and season well.

Transfer the potatoes to a serving bowl, add the sliced spring onions and chopped herbs, then pour over the dressing and season. Add the green beans only when ready to serve and stir to coat everything.
notes: Customise herbs to your taste — replace tarragon with mint if preferred. Try asparagus, runner beans or fresh peas instead of green beans.
